edge_thesis: Mechanism: with a next-open fill and same-bar double-touch rule, the tradable edge is not prediction but structure — take only trend-continuation exposure in assets with persistent institutional flows (US large-cap beta, gold's central-bank bid, BTC post-halving supply squeeze), bracket each with stops sized wider than one typical bar's range so a single bar can never touch both TP and SL, and let stop distance define risk so R stays ≥1.5 on every branch. The other side is the forced seller: deleveraging funds, options dealers hedging gamma, and weak-hand panic sellers who supply my entries on dips; on the flip side, late buyers chase my TPs. I avoid FX and single names where my fill-price uncertainty would break bracket geometry, and use one NAV-priced short-duration bond fund as a drawdown-free net-positive placeholder.

picks.why: US large-cap uptrend continuation; stop sits ~7% below fill zone, outside one week of noise, TP +11% for ~1.8R.
Strongest persistent macro trend (central-bank accumulation); trend drift does the work, stop is a disaster-line, not a noise line.
Post-halving supply squeeze trend; 24/7 tape means fast TP resolution, and a 38k total bracket can never be spanned by one bar.
Low-vol quality compounding as the book's ballast; high probability of net-positive close for tie-break with capped ~-1R tail.
NAV-priced short-duration bond fund: near-certain small positive accrual, zero drawdown contribution, pads net-positive count.
